remarks: This bright and efficient garden-level condo offers everything you need in one smart, stylish package. With 654 square feet of one-level living, this 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit features an open layout that combines the kitchen, dining area, and living room into one inviting space. Newer flooring adds a fresh touch, while oversized closets provide plenty of storage. Enjoy the ease of in-unit laundry, central air, and forced hot air heat for year-round comfort. Step outside to a private patio just steps from the in-ground pool-ideal for summer lounging without ever leaving home. This well-kept community is tucked just minutes from I-95, West Ave, SoNo, and all the best of central Norwalk. Dedicated parking, low-maintenance living, and great proximity make this the smart choice for convenience, comfort, and value. Don't miss a home that's easy to live in and even easier to love.
